# Getting started

The commands `mt help` lists under Getting started. More in [The mt command line](../index.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`doctor`](#doctor) | Check your setup: the API, your sign-in, the namespace, model credentials, and the tools the examples need (exits 1 if a required check fails) *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`init`](#init) | Create a project on this computer: the smallest one that runs, or a copy of a tutorial example (`--list` lists them) *(not in the cloud shell)* |

## doctor

Check your setup: the API, your sign-in, the namespace, model credentials, and the tools the examples need (exits 1 if a required check fails).

```text
mt doctor [folder] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<folder>` | text |  | `.` | The project folder whose agents' models to check; . is the current folder |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

**Not available in the cloud shell:** it checks this computer's setup (its tools and the project on its disk), and the cloud shell runs on the server.

Doesn't need you to sign in.

## init

Create a project on this computer: the smallest one that runs, or a copy of a tutorial example (`--list` lists them).

```text
mt init [folder] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<folder>` | text |  | `.` | The folder to create the project in; . is the current folder |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--example, -e <value>` | text |  |  | A tutorial example to copy: its name (01-hello-agent), number (01) or name without the number (hello-agent) |
| `--lang, -l <value>` | text |  |  | The language of the scripts to include: ts, python or csharp (default: none for a new project, every language for an example) |
| `--list` | flag |  |  | List the tutorial examples instead of creating a project |
| `--force` | flag |  |  | Write into a folder that is not empty (files of the same name are replaced; nothing is deleted) |
| `--no-agent-files` | flag |  |  | Leave out the files for AI coding agents: AGENTS.md, and the Maitento skill in .claude/skills/maitento and .agents/skills/maitento (written by default, never over a file that's already there) |

**Not available in the cloud shell:** it writes a project to the local disk, and the cloud shell has none. Open an example in Build studio instead.

Doesn't need you to sign in.
